description: This Python script generates HTML documentation tables for Spark SQL configuration options by retrieving configuration data via JVM calls and formatting it into HTML tables.

classes.name: SQLConfEntry
classes.description: Named tuple representing a Spark SQL configuration entry with name, default value, description, and version.

methods.name: get_sql_configs
methods.description: Retrieves a list of SQL configuration entries from JVM, either static or runtime based on the group parameter.

methods.name: generate_sql_configs_table_html
methods.description: Generates an HTML table documenting SQL configuration options and writes it to the specified file path.
